buildings.name: Storage Container
buildings.effect: Stacked cargo containers: +2000 storage for ore, metals, fuel and strategics.
buildings.description: Stacked duranium cargo containers on a reinforced pad. Everything you mine or refine needs somewhere to sit: ores, metals, deuterium, dilithium and strategic materials all share one storage space, and when it's full your mines and crawlers stop. Each container adds 2,000 space; crew and latinum need none.
